Name: Mod_Update_Manager
Author: Jared
Description: One-click installer and updater for the crispywhips mod suite (15 mods) via the Install & Update tab: every mod ships bundled inside this DLL, so it works offline with no API key, and a failed apply leaves the installed copy unchanged and can be retried without restarting the game; each row's ? panel shows the bundled mod's own description, a mod already installed under another folder is flagged instead of being installed a second time, and a mod that needs another suite mod or the framework has it installed with it (read from the bundled plugin files, with a Clear button); an opt-in setting keeps the previous version of a suite mod so its row can roll back to it. Also checks your installed mods against Nexus Mods in one request per check (asking per mod only for what that answer leaves, which needs an API key; an opt-in setting checks with no key at all), maps local mods to Nexus IDs, checks your API key when you save it, and provides an in-game update dashboard with optional caching (the Check for Updates button always asks Nexus), scheduling, discovery (opt-in, with a New and updated list of recently updated Nexus mods that you do not have), an opt-in Endorse button that asks before it endorses a mod with your Nexus account, a My Mods list you can sort by name, update status, endorsements or author with one button (favorites stay on top and the choice is remembered), conflict hints (duplicate plugin IDs confirmed from the DLLs, the rest labelled as name-based guesses), missing-dependency detection, and basic analytics. A changelog shows the game build its release notes say the mod was tested on.
